subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: For #25592, should external source/direct chat turns keep automatic final replies with stronger non-final filtering, or migrate toward message_tool/final-only visible delivery by default?
rationale: The current documented default intentionally auto-publishes final text for compatibility, but the security failure mode is exposing internal assistant text to external channels; automation cannot choose that product/security tradeoff safely.

options.title: Keep automatic finals, harden non-final filtering
options.body: Preserve the documented automatic reply default while ensuring commentary, reasoning, unphased pre-tool text, and cron payloads cannot reach external channels as visible messages.

options.title: Move external chats to tool/final-only
options.body: Prefer the strongest privacy boundary by making external visible output explicit, with migration, docs, and tests for users who rely on automatic final replies.

options.title: Treat current main as sufficient
options.body: Close only if maintainers intentionally accept remaining automatic delivery and cron metadata behavior as product-supported rather than a leak.

recommendation.title: Keep automatic finals, harden non-final filtering
recommendation.body: Preserve the documented automatic reply default while ensuring commentary, reasoning, unphased pre-tool text, and cron payloads cannot reach external channels as visible messages.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on visible-reply defaults, cron delivery helpers, and docs for the compatibility tradeoff.
